## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, the change, and the public issue it addresses, if any.

## Verification

State the checks run and their results. Explain any checks not run and any remaining limitations. For interface changes, include sanitized screenshots or describe browser and keyboard verification.

## Documentation and privacy

Describe updated requirements, contracts, or guides when applicable. Confirm that the diff contains no credentials, local data, private instructions, authentication captures, or real parent-calendar links. Keep co-author trailers out of PR descriptions and commit messages.
